meaning: Apply TruthCore.Results.Science.MeasurementCalibration.certificate to build equal-reading profiles with a selected nonzero bias and to identify profiles with a supplied true anchor; use TruthCore.Results.Logic.CorrectionCriterion.characterization to rule out exact classifiers on equal-data fibers and supply an anchored criterion. Uniform soundness alone rules out positive reading-only certificates on each reachable derived datum. The infinite-report case is included by the arbitrary Evidence type.
